notes.content:

Hello Pilots!

We're bringing a huge event to celebrate for launching
MS on Steam! Check out how amazing it is below

▶Event Periods: 2016 / 3.31


▶Event Details

▶Free Item Provided for Buying MS on Steam
▷Bonus item will be provided when you purchase MS on Steam.

▷Items may contain
- Tier 4★ Tickets x2
- Premium Ticket x5
- Bomb x10
- Scroll x50
- Stamina x5
- Upgrader Medal★(30 days)

▶Ranking Event
▷Get ranked higher ever! Item will be provided by each rank.

▷Rank 10 / Stamina x2, Part-time Ticket x2
▷Rank 20 / 3★ Upgrade card x2, Raid ticket x1
▷Rank 30 / Premium Ticket x3
▷Rank 40 / Tier 4~5★ Tickets x1

Thank you.
